title: My alarm failed to go off, went off late or at the wrong time
body:
If your alarm failed to go off, went off late or went off at the wrong time, we are incredibly sorry!

Please contact us using the button below with as much detail as possible about your alarm settings and context around what happened.

Once you’ve done that, it may be wise to delete and then re-install the app, and ensure iOS is up-to-date on your iPhone.
